# Version 4.156.1 (Unreleased)
> **GPU rendering corrections**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.1 improves GPU geometry, clipping, and displacement-filter correctness while retaining Skia m156.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles** — Corrects the transform mapping for corner radii and stroke widths, removes a redundant quarter-turn swap, and clamps corner radii to prevent overlap. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Atlas work after empty flushes** — Corrects Ganesh flush-token tracking so atlas work scheduled during one flush is not incorrectly treated as pending in a later flush. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Graphite clip capacity** — Accounts for unrecorded clip elements without double-counting recorded clips. Draws whose full effective clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass are warned about and skipped rather than exceeding pass capacity. ([#5687](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5687))
- **Displacement-filter precision** — Uses float precision for displacement scale and offset arithmetic so sampling coordinates agree with the filter's computed bounds. Color-channel selection remains half precision. ([#5711](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5711))
- **Native Vulkan synchronization reporting** — Native synchronous submission now requires both queue submission and the fence wait to succeed. Asynchronous submission is unchanged. GRContext.Submit remains void; this does not add a managed failure result or exception. ([#5711](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5711))
